snapshot.title: Unauthorized Root Session on HUOG-PROC01

lines.msg: User: admin, Host: HUOG-PROC01 (10.17.41.11), Source IP: 10.200.4.17 (GCS-02), Action: sudo su -, Session ID: 0x1a2b3c, Authentication: none (no valid login prior to session), Command: /bin/bash
Context: No prior login in auth.log. Session initiated from a previously unknown source (GCS-02) and used a cached service account credential (account: svc-nas-01).

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms the root-level compromise of HUOG-PROC01 via a stolen service account. The technical team must trace the vector to GCS-02’s NAS mount session and report to the MSSP immediately.
